study_identification_part.si4_title: Probing individual-level structural atrophy in frontal glioma patients

cm1_research_objectives.reason: The study clearly states its objectives: "In this study, we aim to investigate whether individual frontal glioma patients display unique structural alterations....". It also describes the purpose of the individual-level structural abnormality detection method.
cm1_research_objectives.supporting_text: In this study, we aim to investigate whether individual frontal glioma patients display unique structural alterations, whether common patterns of structural alterations exist among glioma patients, and whether the individual-level atrophy patterns are correlated with patient-specific tumor characteristics.

nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.reason: The study states "All healthy controls were recruited from the local community and universities" and provides age/sex info. It lists exclusion criteria for patients but implies similar standards for controls (age-matched). It does not explicitly detail exclusion criteria specific to HC (other than implying they are healthy) or image quality standards (other than "manual correction" for patients, not mentioned for HC).
nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.supporting_text: All healthy controls were recruited from the local community and universities. ... A final cohort of ... 51 age-matched healthy controls (24 men, 27 women, age = 42.6 ± 9.7 years, all right-handed) were included in the study. ... Exclusion criteria were patients with previous cranial surgery, neuropsychiatric comorbidities and any contraindications to MR scanning such as metal implants.

nm2_handling_of_covariates_reference_coh.reason: The study used a GLM to model brain volume with age, sex, and TIV as covariates.
nm2_handling_of_covariates_reference_coh.supporting_text: General linear model (GLM) was adopted to discover the relationship between brain volume and variables including age, sex and total intracranial volume (TIV) using the following equation...
nm2_handling_of_covariates_reference_coh.location: Methods, Generation of individual structural abnormality map

nm3_data_sources_reference_cohort.reason: The study states that healthy controls were recruited from the local community and universities and scanned at Beijing Tiantan Hospital.
nm3_data_sources_reference_cohort.supporting_text: All healthy controls were recruited from the local community and universities. ... All subjects were scanned with a Philips Ingenia 3.0 T MRI scanner at Beijing Tiantan Hospital.
nm3_data_sources_reference_cohort.location: Methods, Subjects; Methods, Structural MRI acquisition

nm4_image_acquisition_protocol.reason: The study specifies the scanner (Philips Ingenia 3.0 T) and parameters for the T1 sequence used for the normative model.
nm4_image_acquisition_protocol.supporting_text: All subjects were scanned with a Philips Ingenia 3.0 T MRI scanner at Beijing Tiantan Hospital. For both glioma patients and healthy controls, T1 sequence was collected with the following parameters: TR: 6.5 ms, TE: 3.0 ms, flip angle: 8°, voxel size: 1 × 1 × 1 mm3, image dimension: 256 × 256 × 196.

nm5_data_preprocessing.reason: Preprocessing steps using CAT12 (skull stripping, bias correction, segmentation, normalization, smoothing) are described.
nm5_data_preprocessing.supporting_text: Individual T1 images were processed using the Computational Anatomy Toolbox 12 (CAT12...) ... First, skull stripping and correction for bias-field inhomogeneities were performed. Then, the whole brain image was segmented... followed by normalization... smoothed with a 4-mm full width at half maxima (FWHM) Gaussian kernel.

nm6_internal_data_validation_reference_c.reason: The study describes building the normative model using the healthy controls' data (GLM) but does not mention any data partitioning strategy (e.g., cross-validation) for internal validation of the model itself. It applies the model to patients.
nm6_internal_data_validation_reference_c.supporting_text: First, a normative brain volume model was constructed using the healthy controls' data. ... Then, for each glioma patient, an individual SAM was generated...
nm6_internal_data_validation_reference_c.location: Methods, Generation of individual structural abnormality map

nm7_external_data_validation_reference_c.reason: There is no mention of applying the normative model to an independent external dataset of healthy individuals.

nm8_normative_modeling_approach.reason: The study specifies using a General Linear Model (GLM) to estimate normative brain volume based on covariates. It describes the equation and the W-score calculation.
nm8_normative_modeling_approach.supporting_text: General linear model (GLM) was adopted to discover the relationship between brain volume and variables including age, sex and total intracranial volume (TIV)... Using this approach, the normative GM and WM volume models were separately constructed.
nm8_normative_modeling_approach.location: Methods, Generation of individual structural abnormality map

cr5_clinical_assessment_measures.supporting_text: Neuropsychological testing was conducted ... using the Montreal Cognitive Assessment (MOCA) test. ... Histological confirmation ... criteria of the World Health Organization (WHO)... Molecular markers... were all collected.

cr6_interpretation_of_deviation_scores.reason: The study explains the meaning of the W score (deviation from healthy controls, higher score = higher atrophy probability) and defines a threshold (|W|>6). It discusses the clinical implications of the findings.
cr6_interpretation_of_deviation_scores.supporting_text: Here, the W score essentially reflects the degree of deviation of each patient from the healthy normal controls, and the larger the W score in one voxel, the higher the atrophy probability in that location. A threshold of |W|> 6 was selected...
cr6_interpretation_of_deviation_scores.location: Methods, Generation of individual structural abnormality map
